messages:
maria: Quick sync — field customer wants a "quiet" onprem rollout option for VPC packaging. Goal: let us ship to 3 customers with minimal ops noise and zero control-plane drift.
lee: asked what 'quiet' means operationally?
maria: mainly: (1) no auto-updates, (2) preserve customer egress IPs, (3) limited telemetry retention, (4) manual rollback window. keep defaults conservative.
arnold: runtime note: to preserve egress IP we need NAT/egress pinning in the installer. that affects operator shim: https://confluence.example/redwood/onprem-egress-pin (short link)
sam: proposes a gated flag: --quiet-rollout=true
sam: suggested checklist: preflight K8s version, egress-preserve test, BGP session stability, canary worker pool, rollback script.
lee: customer asks for upgrade path with <5m downtime. can we support in-place patch with streaming state?
arnold: streaming KV cache makes <5m hard at high seq lengths. we can target 99th pct < 10m for initial customers. nina: we should capture this as a launch gate.
nina: launch gates proposal: [1] installer e2e passes with real customer topology, [2] egress ip preserved in 100% of test cases, [3] rollback verified on 2k token/day workload, [4] runbook & field acceptance signoff.
maria: @lee @nina love it. field will accept 10m if we provide scheduled maintenance window and clear rollback steps.
sam: ops playbook snippet:
```
# enable quiet rollout
redwood-installer --mode=onprem --vpc --quiet-rollout \
  --egress-preserve=pin --telemetry=low
```
sam: also add a health-check endpoint that returns 'drift: none' and 'egress: pinned'
devops-bot: Preflight checks: k8s-1.25 ok, egress-preserve test: FAIL on customer topology A (AS path rewrite). See logs: /var/logs/preflight-5043219876.log
arnold: thanks bot — let's triage topology A tomorrow. likely BGP policy conflict. recommend a field runbook note for netops: 'ensure no AS path mutation between edge and customer router'.
lee: question on pricing/comms—if we require maintenance, do we bill as support? field: they'll accept free patching for first 3 customers.
maria: ok capture in roadmap: Q2 quiet-rollout pilot (3 customers) -> Q3 scale if gates pass. I'll add tickets: RD-987 quiet-rollout flag, RD-988 preflight fixes, RD-989 field runbook.
nina: add evals to Redwood Optimize to track token regression during quiet rollout.
maria: wrapping — next step: meeting w/field Wed 10am to align on customer A topology. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
